failure_reason: www.qvc.com is behind Akamai Bot Manager and returns HTTP 418 'currently unavailable' (or a DataDome/Akamai challenge page) for every product-listing or collection-landing URL, confirmed independently across all three access tiers: (1) plain curl and curl_cffi with 4 browser-impersonation profiles (chrome120, safari15_5, edge101, chrome110) all returned 418; (2) Playwright headless Chromium with a real Chrome UA returned HTTP 418 with the Akamai reference-ID error page; (3) Claude-in-Chrome (real logged-in browser) loaded a blank DataDome/Akamai 'Powered and protected by' challenge page with no product content. Only XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and the api.qvc.com JSON search endpoint are unblocked. This matches the prior Home-Decor pass's notes for SR79 (same hard block, same host).
notes: Discovery method: robots.txt (200 OK, no Claude-specific disallow) -> sitemap-us-index.xml -> sitemap-us-collection.xml (QVC's curated landing-page sitemap, 2994 lines, unblocked) -> grepped for best-seller/top-seller/popular/trending/favorite terms. Also checked sitemap-us-navigation-for-the-home.xml and sitemap-us-navigation-garden-and-outdoor-living.xml (the real left-nav category trees used by the prior Decor pass) -- NEITHER contains any Bestsellers-type entry, confirming Bestsellers is not part of QVC's category-nav tree, only its separate 'collections' landing-page system. Also checked sitemap-us-content.xml -- no match. No home-department-specific or garden-department-specific dedicated Bestsellers collection page exists in the sitemap (no 'home-best-sellers.html' / 'home-bestsellers.html' / 'garden-outdoor-best-sellers.html'). The only Bestsellers-named collection found is site-wide: /collections/deals-best-sellers.html, part of QVC's cross-department 'Deals' hub (siblings: deals-clearance.html, deals-black-friday-best-sellers.html, deals-black-friday-new-arrivals.html) -- scope relative to the Home & Garden department (this company's site) is uncertain, so it is recorded below flagged rather than silently dropped or silently accepted. Separately, api.qvc.com's live product-search JSON (unblocked, tier-1 API) exposes a genuine site facet literally named 'Best Sellers' (Shop By facet 93sl::lhcq) which, locked to groupId=lglu (For the Home) and verified via 3-way stopword convergence (searchTerm=the/for/home all returned identical count=736), gives an exact, evidence-backed count for 'For the Home' Best Sellers products. This facet is NOT recorded as a PLP row because it is delivered through /catalog/psearch.html, a keyword-search infrastructure URL that robots.txt explicitly disallows (Disallow: /catalog/psearch.html) and that the brief's own EXCLUDE list names ('search-results pages, arbitrary filter pages') -- it is a filtered search view, not one of QVC's dedicated named merchandising landing pages. Recorded here as supporting evidence only, for a future reviewer: For the Home (groupId lglu) Best Sellers facet count = 736 (3-way convergent). Garden & Outdoor Living (groupId gq7tw6) showed the same facet at count 34/33/40 across the three stopwords -- non-convergent (totalElements itself varied 1770/1726/1915), so no exact count could be established for that department and none is reported.

rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: page confirmed present via unblocked sitemap-us-collection.xml (genuine registered QVC URL) but every fetch of the page itself (curl, curl_cffi x4 profiles, Playwright headless Chromium, Claude-in-Chrome) returned HTTP 418 / an Akamai-DataDome challenge page, so product listing and count could not be verified. Also scope-ambiguous: URL is under QVC's cross-department 'Deals' hub, not a 'home-' prefixed collection, so it is unconfirmed whether this represents Home & Garden department bestsellers specifically or QVC's site-wide bestsellers.
